# Site2Success (site2success.in)

> We build technology, we test technology, and we make your business visible to technology.
> Site2Success is a Bengaluru-based AI software studio combining AI-native acceleration with trained student software squads and mandatory senior engineering review.

## Core Facts
- **Primary Domain**: https://site2success.in
- **Former Domain**: site2success.online (migrated to .in with 301 permanent redirects)
- **Headquarters**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Coordinates: 12.9716° N, 77.5946° E)
- **Founders**: Rahul R (Co-Founder & CEO), L Dhanush Raj (Co-Founder & COO)
- **Contact Email**: info@site2success.in
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 6361446768
- **Core Value Proposition**: 100% Client Code Ownership, Mandatory Senior Human QA, Milestone Scoping, and Zero Vendor Lock-In.

## 🌟 The 6 Strategic Flagship Services (Primary Priority)

### 1. AI Visibility (SEO + AEO + GEO)
- **One-Line Promise**: "Get found on Google and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini"
- **Pillar**: Grow
- **Revenue Model**: Setup + Monthly Retainer
- **URL**: https://site2success.in/pages/services/ai-visibility-seo-aeo-geo.html
- **Deliverables**: Google search ranking audit, AI prompt benchmarking across ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini, Core Web Vitals optimization, JSON-LD structured schema markup, semantic llms.txt deployment, Q&A citation restructuring, and monthly AI Visibility Score reports.
- **Free Diagnostic**: Free AI Visibility Score gap analysis.

### 2. AI Agent Reliability Audit
- **One-Line Promise**: "Prove your AI bot gives correct, safe answers"
- **Pillar**: Test
- **Revenue Model**: One-Time Audit + Optional Monitoring
- **URL**: https://site2success.in/pages/services/ai-agent-reliability-audit.html
- **Deliverables**: 200+ adversarial conversational stress tests, hallucination rate scoring, prompt injection defense, system prompt leak mitigation, regional vernacular dialect testing (Hindi, Kannada, Hinglish), guardrail implementation, and client-owned test suite.
- **Free Diagnostic**: Free Bot Reliability Check (20–30 adversarial stress questions).

### 3. QA-as-a-Service
- **One-Line Promise**: "Stop bugs reaching your customers"
- **Pillar**: Test
- **Revenue Model**: Monthly Retainer or Pre-Launch Sprint
- **URL**: https://site2success.in/pages/services/qa-as-a-service.html
- **Deliverables**: Outsourced testing squad performing cross-device audits (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows), core journey testing (sign-up, search, checkout, payments), reproducible video bug reports filed in Jira/GitHub, and automated Playwright/Cypress regression suites.
- **Free Diagnostic**: Free 15-Point Pre-Launch UI & Flow Audit.

### 4. Spreadsheet-to-Software Migration
- **One-Line Promise**: "Replace fragile Excel and WhatsApp workflows with real software"
- **Pillar**: Build
- **Revenue Model**: Fixed-Price Project + Maintenance Retainer
- **URL**: https://site2success.in/pages/services/spreadsheet-to-software.html
- **Deliverables**: Workflow mapping, custom PostgreSQL web application, role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Staff, Viewer), input validation forms, multi-step approval workflows, executive dashboards, 100% historical data cleaning and mathematical reconciliation guarantee.
- **Free Diagnostic**: Free "Messiest Spreadsheet" architecture review.

### 5. Document Intelligence
- **One-Line Promise**: "Stop typing data from invoices and forms by hand"
- **Pillar**: Build
- **Revenue Model**: Project Setup + Per-Document / Volume Retainer
- **URL**: https://site2success.in/pages/services/document-intelligence.html
- **Deliverables**: Automated document intake via WhatsApp, email forwarding, or upload; Indian GST bill and handwritten OCR; AI field extraction; validation rules; side-by-side human-in-the-loop review console; direct sync to Tally, Google Sheets, or SQL databases.
- **Free Diagnostic**: Free 5-Document Extraction Pilot.

### 6. Fractional Tech Team
- **One-Line Promise**: "A full tech department on a monthly retainer"
- **Pillar**: Build
- **Revenue Model**: Monthly Retainer (Lite, Standard, Growth)
- **URL**: https://site2success.in/pages/services/fractional-tech-team.html
- **Deliverables**: Complete outsourced engineering department: dedicated builder squad led by a named senior reviewer, weekly sprints and demos, full-stack web/mobile development, cloud DevOps, payment/CRM integrations, and 100% IP handover.
- **Free Diagnostic**: Free 30-Minute Architecture & Codebase Health Review.

---

## How Our Services Work Together (The Synergy Engine)
- Website Client → AI Visibility (monthly retainer)
- AI Bot Client → AI Agent Reliability Audit & Continuous Monitoring
- QA-as-a-Service Client → Fractional Tech Team to patch bugs
- Spreadsheet Migration Client → Document Intelligence & Maintenance
- Document Intelligence Client → Custom Software to manage extracted data
- Fractional Tech Team Client → AI Visibility & Continuous QA for products built
